supplements.title: Baicalein downregulates kinase-based and estrogen signaling pathways in breast cancer stem cells: an integrated bioinformatics and gene expression study.
supplements.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, suppresses key genes and pathways that promote breast cancer stem cell survival and drug resistance.

supplements.title: Broccoli-mediated biogenic gold/platinum nanohybrid for antimicrobial, antioxidant, antidiabetic, anticancer, and wound healing applications.
supplements.summary: Broccoli-derived gold/platinum nanoparticles selectively kill liver cancer cells while sparing normal cells and accelerate wound healing.

supplements.title: [Mechanism of vitamin K2 in modulating matrix Gla protein to inhibit tumor growth in inflammation-associated colorectal cancer model mice].
supplements.summary: Vitamin K2 slows colorectal cancer growth in mice by increasing a protein that activates tumor-suppressing pathways.

supplements.title: Restoration of Immune Surveillance in Prostate Cancer Prevention by Sulforaphane in Hi-Myc Mice.
supplements.summary: Broccoli compound sulforaphane prevents prostate cancer by boosting immune cells that fight tumors in mice.

supplements.title: Deglycosylated alfalfa saponins enhance antioxidant capacity and gene expression in obese mice.
supplements.summary: Deglycosylated alfalfa saponins reduced weight gain and inflammation while boosting antioxidant protection in obese mice.

supplements.title: Integrative network pharmacology and machine learning identify potential targets of indole-3-lactic acid in colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified four genes that indole-3-lactic acid, a gut bacteria metabolite, may target to fight colorectal cancer through multiple pathways.

supplements.title: Quercetin prevents age-related hearing loss in C57BL/6J mice by activating mitophagy and inhibiting the NLRP3 inflammasome.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a natural plant compound, prevented age-related hearing loss in mice by reducing inflammation and improving mitochondrial cleanup.

supplements.title: Investigation of the impact of resveratrol on sublethal-dose ALA-PDT in glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol combined with photodynamic therapy enhanced cancer cell death in glioblastoma, a deadly brain cancer.

supplements.title: Integrated computational, pharmacological and molecular investigations of piperitone in mitigating Alzheimer disease pathology by targeting cholinesterases, β-secretase and neuroinflammation.
supplements.summary: Piperitone, a natural compound, showed promise for Alzheimer's disease by reducing brain inflammation, improving memory, and protecting neurons through multiple mechanisms.

supplements.title: Pogostone Suppresses Microglial NLRP3 Inflammasome Activation-Promoted Remyelination Through RXRγ Regulation of Mitophagy.
supplements.summary: Pogostone promotes nerve sheath regrowth in multiple sclerosis by reducing harmful inflammation through a specific cellular cleanup pathway.

supplements.title: Integrative in vitro and digital twin in silico evaluation of selected natural compounds' proapoptotic and antiproliferative effects on gynecological cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Natural compounds caffeic acid and its derivative showed promise in killing gynecological cancer cells by triggering cell death pathways.

supplements.title: The multifaceted effects of rosmarinic acid on breast cancer, regulating autophagy and increasing apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Rosmarinic acid combined with Paclitaxel kills breast cancer cells better in lab tests by triggering cell death and blocking autophagy.

supplements.title: The combination of human milk oligosaccharides 3-fucosyllactose and 3'-sialyllactose alleviates LPS-induced damage to intestinal epithelial cells.
supplements.summary: Two milk compounds combined protect intestinal cells from inflammation and damage by reducing harmful inflammatory markers and strengthening cell barriers.

supplements.title: Prevention of colorectal cancer and modulation of murine gut microbiota using functional meats.
supplements.summary: Enhanced processed meats with plant compounds and probiotics reduced colorectal tumor development in mice through gut health improvements.

supplements.title: Flavonoids and polycystic ovary syndrome.
supplements.summary: Flavonoids from plants may safely treat PCOS by reducing inflammation, lowering androgen levels, and improving fertility without current medication side effects.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate microemulsion eyedrops for treating nitrogen mustard induced corneal injury.
off_label.summary: Fenofibrate eyedrops effectively treat nitrogen mustard-induced corneal injury by restoring protective protein levels and reducing inflammation in rat models.

off_label.title: Metabolic, microbial, and pharmacological stimuli elicit distinct lipidomic and cytokine responses in human placenta.
off_label.summary: Different stressors trigger distinct lipid and immune responses in placental tissue, with bacterial exposure causing inflammation linked to pregnancy complications.

off_label.title: Dual-targeting strategies for cancer and diabetes: Converging pharmacological pathways and repurposed therapies.
off_label.summary: Researchers propose treating cancer and type 2 diabetes simultaneously using shared drug targets like metformin to address their interconnected biological pathways.

off_label.title: Drugs and natural bioactive products in modulation of inflammatory pathways in cancer: preclinical and clinical evidence of inflammasomes, cytokine networks, and macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: Drugs and natural products that reduce inflammation by targeting immune cells and signaling pathways show promise in slowing cancer growth and improving treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Reprogramming innate immunity to overcome endocrine resistance in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking STAT3 signaling in immune cells could restore hormone therapy effectiveness in resistant estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer.

off_label.title: Modulation of the HMGB1/TLR4 Pathway by Montelukast in PTZ-Induced Epilepsy: Alleviating Neuroinflammatory Oxidative Stress and Seizure Severity.
off_label.summary: Montelukast reduces seizure severity and neuroinflammation in epilepsy models, offering potential as an alternative antiepileptic treatment.

off_label.title: Cuproptosis-associated PDHA1 promotes sarcoma progression and immunotherapy responsiveness via the E2F1-PD-L1 axis: a multi-omics and clinical validation study.
off_label.summary: PDHA1 drives sarcoma progression and immune evasion through E2F1-PD-L1 signaling, offering new immunotherapy targets.

off_label.title: DNA methyltransferase inhibition is a therapeutic vulnerability in VHL-deficient renal cell carcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: DNA methyltransferase inhibitors effectively kill VHL-deficient renal cell carcinoma by reactivating a suppressed tumor-fighting gene.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis-driven in situ vaccine-like antitumor effects: NIR-triggered IFBM hydrogel synergizes with sorafenib to unleash systemic antitumor immunity.
off_label.summary: A light-activated hydrogel combined with sorafenib triggers cancer cell death, activating immune cells to fight tumors and eliminate distant metastases.

off_label.title: Distinct H3K27 methylation states drive cellular responses to the histone demethylase inhibitor GSK-J4 in ovarian cancer cells.
off_label.summary: GSK-J4 inhibitor reduces ovarian cancer cell growth by altering histone methylation, with effects dependent on androgen receptor signaling.

off_label.title: A resveratrol derivative RVX-208 inhibits PD-1/PD-L1 to restrain non-small cell lung cancer as an immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: RVX-208, a resveratrol derivative, enhances immune attack on non-small cell lung cancer by reducing PD-1 and PD-L1 levels.

off_label.title: Calcium channel blockers affect angiogenesis by modulating inflammatory factors: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
off_label.summary: Calcium channel blockers inhibit tumor blood vessel growth by reducing inflammatory factors like IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-α.

off_label.title: Sodium valproate drives propionylation-mediated epigenetic reprogramming to enhance mesothelin CAR-T cell therapy in solid tumors.
off_label.summary: Sodium valproate improves CAR-T cell therapy for ovarian and breast cancer by enhancing cell persistence, migration, and tumor-fighting ability.

off_label.title: The Influence of Extracellular Citrate in Physiological Concentration on the Proliferation of Malignant Melanoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking citrate uptake in melanoma cells with gluconate stops citrate-driven tumor growth, suggesting a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Glutamine antagonist DON attenuates chikungunya virus-induced myositis by suppressing inflammatory activation in a murine model.
off_label.summary: DON, a glutamine inhibitor, reduces chikungunya virus-induced muscle inflammation by suppressing immune cell activation, without affecting viral control.

biomarkers.title: Screening of peptide inhibitors targeting YAP-TEAD4 interaction: affinity evaluation and anti-AML cell activity.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a peptide that blocks a protein interaction driving acute myeloid leukemia, successfully reducing cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

biomarkers.title: Baicalein downregulates kinase-based and estrogen signaling pathways in breast cancer stem cells: an integrated bioinformatics and gene expression study.
biomarkers.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, suppresses key genes and pathways that promote breast cancer stem cell survival and drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Broccoli-mediated biogenic gold/platinum nanohybrid for antimicrobial, antioxidant, antidiabetic, anticancer, and wound healing applications.
biomarkers.summary: Broccoli-derived gold/platinum nanoparticles selectively kill liver cancer cells while sparing normal cells and accelerate wound healing.

biomarkers.title: Adhesion forces between macrophages and cancer cells promote early tumor development.
biomarkers.summary: Physical adhesion forces between macrophages and lung cancer cells drive early tumor growth through integrin interactions.

biomarkers.title: Can micro-CT distinguish between solid lung tumors? A comparative evaluation including solid adenocarcinoma, non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma, and carcinoid tumor.
biomarkers.summary: Micro-CT imaging shows promise for distinguishing between three types of solid lung tumors without requiring immunohistochemistry tests.

biomarkers.title: [Mechanism of vitamin K2 in modulating matrix Gla protein to inhibit tumor growth in inflammation-associated colorectal cancer model mice].
biomarkers.summary: Vitamin K2 slows colorectal cancer growth in mice by increasing a protein that activates tumor-suppressing pathways.

biomarkers.title: Self-assembled multicomponent prodrugs with GSH/ROS site-responsiveness enable spatiotemporally controlled release for treating resistant NSCLC.
biomarkers.summary: A three-drug nanoparticle overcomes lung cancer resistance by simultaneously disrupting microtubules, inhibiting DNA repair, and damaging mitochondria.

biomarkers.title: ROS-responsive self-immolative polymeric prodrug for nitrosative stress-mediated cancer therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a polymer drug that activates in tumors to release nitric oxide and deplete protective molecules, triggering cancer cell death in mice.

biomarkers.title: Engineered virus-derived platform enables glutathione depletion and cuproptosis for enhanced cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Engineered virus-derived peptides deplete cancer cells' protective glutathione, triggering copper-induced cell death and boosting immune response against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Bacteria-targeted dual-lock delivery for closed-loop immune modulation in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A targeted delivery system kills tumor bacteria and remodels barriers in colorectal cancer, enhancing immune cell infiltration and checkpoint immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: A self-amplifying cuproptosis nanomedicine to overcome immunosuppression by blocking tumor-derived exosomes for enhancing lung cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: A new nanoparticle treatment blocks tumor exosomes and triggers copper-induced cell death, enhancing immune responses against lung cancer.

biomarkers.title: Pulmonary delivery of glycine-induced outer membrane vesicles as in situ vaccines for metastatic lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Inhaled vaccine made from bacterial particles successfully suppressed metastatic lung cancer by boosting immune cells to attack tumors.

biomarkers.title: Structurally-defined non-cationic docosahexaenoic acid based siRNA-micelles for safe and effective combinatorial glioblastoma therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed safe, brain-penetrating nanoparticles delivering genetic therapy that targets two pathways to effectively treat glioblastoma in mice.

biomarkers.title: Microbiome and metabolite biomarkers of CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary: Specific gut bacteria and metabolites may predict treatment success and side effects in CAR T-cell therapy for aggressive lymphoma.

biomarkers.title: Outcomes of relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia after menin inhibition failure.
biomarkers.summary: Acute myeloid leukemia patients who fail menin inhibitor treatment have poor outcomes, though some respond to venetoclax-based therapy or switching menin inhibitors.

trials.title: Hybrid microneedle patch for administration of measles and rubella vaccine with an on-patient medical record.
trials.summary: Researchers created microneedle patches that deliver measles and rubella vaccines while invisibly storing medical records in skin using near-infrared particles.

trials.title: Microbiome and metabolite biomarkers of CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: Specific gut bacteria and metabolites may predict treatment success and side effects in CAR T-cell therapy for aggressive lymphoma.

trials.title: Outcomes of relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia after menin inhibition failure.
trials.summary: Acute myeloid leukemia patients who fail menin inhibitor treatment have poor outcomes, though some respond to venetoclax-based therapy or switching menin inhibitors.

trials.title: Real-world comparative effectiveness of Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors in relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: Zanubrutinib showed longer survival benefits compared to ibrutinib in relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma patients.

trials.title: First-in-human phase 1 study of RO7119929, an oral TLR7 agonist prodrug, in patients with advanced primary or metastatic liver cancers.
trials.summary: RO7119929, an oral drug that activates immune cells in the liver, shows promise in early testing for advanced liver cancer patients.

trials.title: Restoration of Immune Surveillance in Prostate Cancer Prevention by Sulforaphane in Hi-Myc Mice.
trials.summary: Broccoli compound sulforaphane prevents prostate cancer by boosting immune cells that fight tumors in mice.

trials.title: Exploring DNA Damage Repair Therapeutics in Prostate Cancer beyond BRCAness.
trials.summary: Researchers explore DNA repair inhibitors for prostate cancer beyond BRCA mutations to improve patient selection and overcome treatment resistance.

trials.title: Surgical Resections for Hepatocellular Carcinomas Arising From Fontan-Associated Liver Disease; Open, Laparoscopic and Robotic Hepatectomies.
trials.summary: Surgeons successfully used open, laparoscopic, and robotic methods to remove liver cancer in patients with Fontan heart surgery complications.

trials.title: Photothermally Triggered Intratumoral In Situ Drug Synthesis: A Smart Nanoplatform for NIR-Controlled Precise Activation of Antitumor Precursors.
trials.summary: A nanoplatform uses near-infrared light to trigger drug synthesis directly inside tumors, combining chemotherapy with ferroptosis for precise cancer treatment.

trials.title: Prognostic impact of onset timing on response to methylprednisolone pulse therapy for idiopathic pneumonia syndrome after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.
trials.summary: Late-onset pneumonia after stem cell transplant shows poor response to steroid therapy, suggesting alternative treatments may be needed.

trials.title: Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) genetic testing and treatment with 5-fluoropyrimidines in cancer patients: prevalence of variants with decreased activity and chemotherapy outcomes.
trials.summary: Genetic testing for DPYD variants can identify cancer patients at risk of dangerous reactions to common chemotherapy drugs.

trials.title: Radiomics-driven prediction of pathologic complete response in non-mass breast cancer using post-neoadjuvant chemotherapy preoperative dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a computer analysis tool using MRI scans to predict which non-mass breast cancer patients will completely respond to chemotherapy.

trials.title: Dendrimers with a far-red NDI fluorescent core for efficient and traceable gene and RNA delivery.
trials.summary: Fluorescent dendrimers with an NDI core efficiently deliver GPX4 siRNA to colon cancer cells, enhancing ferroptosis-inducing drug effectiveness.

trials.title: Lung-Accumulating Mucin 5AC Silencing by Noninflammatory Lipid Nanoparticles for Asthma Treatment.
trials.summary: Researchers developed special nanoparticles that safely silence mucus-producing genes, effectively treating asthma and related lung diseases in mouse models.

trials.title: Rational Design of Potent and Orally Efficacious PI3Kα/δ Degrader for PIK3CA Mutant Breast Cancer without Hyperglycemic Liability.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new drug (D5) that effectively destroys cancer-causing proteins in PIK3CA mutant breast cancer while avoiding blood sugar side effects.
